title: Binary Trees With Factors
description: Calculate the number of binary trees possible where each non-leaf node is the product of its children.
pseudocode: 1. Sort arr; 2. Initialize dp map with each element as 1; 3. For each i in arr: For each j in arr where j <= i: If i % j == 0 and i/j in dp: dp[i] += dp[j] * dp[i/j]; 4. Return sum(dp.values()) % 10^9+7

steps.note: Processing 2: No factors found, count remains 1
Processing 4: Factor 2 found (4/2 = 2). dp[4] += dp[2] * dp[2] -> 1 + 1*1 = 2
